items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Or Darnell or Stump Evans or.

ctx.x: I had forgotten all about him. I see.
Or Darnell or Stump Evans or. It wasn't Darnell. It wasn't Darnell.
Uh. Or could it be Ralph Brown or uh. Maybe Stump. That name sounds familiar. Stump Evans. It may.
